nodes.text:
Do you want to hear the one about the drowned legionary?

Halyard has heard it. Halyard has heard it a number of times.

A drowned legionary walks into the Deck.

That's it. That's the whole joke - he walks into the Deck. Everyone screams. Two people fall off the rail.

Last spring. We got him back off the boards eventually.

I have found that if you tell a bad thing as a joke often enough it stops being a bad thing and starts being a bad joke. That is the entire method.

No. But it is what I have instead of one.

Give it a year down here and you will have one too, and yours will also not be a joke.
